metadata.source: Research compilation — historical fiction and world literature
metadata.description: Final batch to push past 3,000 entities — focused on works unlikely to be duplicated and niche historical figures.

figures.name: Mary Anning
figures.title: Paleontologist
figures.description: Self-taught fossil hunter who made crucial discoveries along the Dorset coast, including the first correctly identified ichthyosaur skeleton, largely unrecognized in her lifetime

figures.name: Hildegard of Bingen
figures.title: Abbess, mystic, and polymath
figures.description: Benedictine abbess who composed music, wrote theological and scientific works, and corresponded with popes and emperors — one of the great medieval minds

figures.name: Hypatia of Alexandria
figures.title: Philosopher and mathematician
figures.description: The last great pagan philosopher of antiquity, head of the Neoplatonic school in Alexandria, murdered by a Christian mob in one of history's most infamous acts of violence against intellectuals

figures.name: Hatice Sultan
figures.title: Ottoman princess
figures.description: Favorite sister of Suleiman the Magnificent and wife of Grand Vizier Ibrahim Pasha, wielding significant political influence in the Ottoman court

figures.name: Oishi Kuranosuke
figures.title: Japanese samurai
figures.description: Leader of the Forty-Seven Ronin who avenged their lord's death in the most famous act of samurai loyalty in Japanese history

figures.name: Basho
figures.title: Japanese poet
figures.description: The greatest haiku poet, whose The Narrow Road to the Deep North elevated haiku to a literary art form and remains the most famous work of Japanese travel literature

figures.name: Yaa Asantewaa
figures.title: Queen Mother of Ejisu
figures.description: Led the Ashanti war of resistance against British colonialism in the Gold Coast, one of the last major wars of African resistance to European imperialism

figures.name: Menelik II
figures.title: Emperor of Ethiopia
figures.description: Ethiopian emperor who defeated the Italian invasion at the Battle of Adwa in 1896, the most decisive African victory against European colonialism

figures.name: Enheduanna
figures.title: High Priestess and poet
figures.description: Daughter of Sargon of Akkad and the first named author in human history, her hymns to the goddess Inanna are the oldest signed literary works

figures.name: Wallada bint al-Mustakfi
figures.title: Umayyad princess and poet
figures.description: Andalusian princess and one of the greatest female poets of the Arab world, known for her wit, independence, and scandalous love affair with Ibn Zaydun

figures.name: Nefertiti
figures.title: Queen of Egypt
figures.description: Great Royal Wife of Akhenaten whose painted bust is one of the most iconic works of ancient art, she may have briefly ruled as pharaoh after her husband's death

figures.name: Zenobia
figures.title: Queen of Palmyra
figures.description: Syrian queen who conquered Egypt and much of the Eastern Roman Empire before being defeated by Emperor Aurelian, one of antiquity's most powerful women

figures.name: Khutulun
figures.title: Mongol princess and warrior
figures.description: Great-great-granddaughter of Genghis Khan who famously refused to marry any man who could not defeat her in wrestling, reportedly winning 10,000 horses

works.title: Agora
works.creator: Alejandro Amenabar
works.description: Historical drama about Hypatia of Alexandria, the philosopher and mathematician caught between the rising tide of Christianity and the fading world of classical learning

works.title: The 47 Ronin
works.creator: Kenji Mizoguchi
works.description: Classic Japanese film depicting the famous revenge of the 47 ronin, considered one of the greatest Japanese films ever made

works.title: The Passion of the Christ
works.creator: Mel Gibson
works.description: Controversial and graphically violent depiction of the last 12 hours of Jesus Christ's life, filmed in Aramaic, Latin, and Hebrew

works.title: Papillon
works.creator: Franklin J. Schaffner
works.description: Drama about a man wrongly convicted of murder who is sent to the penal colony on Devil's Island and makes repeated daring escape attempts

works.title: The Man in the Iron Mask
works.creator: Randall Wallace
works.description: Adaptation of Dumas's novel featuring the aging Musketeers plotting to replace the tyrannical King Louis XIV with his secret twin brother

works.title: The Last of the Mohicans
works.creator: Michael Mann
works.description: Adventure epic set during the French and Indian War following the frontiersman Hawkeye as he protects two women amid the conflict between British and French forces

works.title: Apocalypse Now
works.creator: Francis Ford Coppola
works.description: Epic war film loosely based on Heart of Darkness, following a captain on a mission upriver into Cambodia to assassinate a rogue colonel who has gone mad

works.title: Full Metal Jacket
works.creator: Stanley Kubrick
works.description: Vietnam War film following a platoon of Marines from the dehumanizing boot camp to the Battle of Hue during the Tet Offensive

works.title: Platoon
works.creator: Oliver Stone
works.description: Semi-autobiographical war film about a young soldier's experience in Vietnam, torn between two sergeants who represent the moral extremes of warfare

works.title: Come and See
works.creator: Elem Klimov
works.description: Soviet anti-war masterpiece following a Belarusian boy through the horrors of Nazi occupation, widely considered the most harrowing war film ever made

works.title: Das Boot
works.creator: Wolfgang Petersen
works.description: Claustrophobic submarine thriller following the crew of a German U-boat during the Battle of the Atlantic, capturing the terror and futility of submarine warfare

works.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
works.creator: David Lean
works.description: Epic about British POWs forced to build a railway bridge for the Japanese, exploring the thin line between duty and collaboration in wartime

works.title: The Thin Red Line
works.creator: Terrence Malick
works.description: Philosophical war film following American soldiers during the Battle of Guadalcanal, meditating on nature, death, and the meaning of combat

works.title: Letters from Iwo Jima
works.creator: Clint Eastwood
works.description: The Battle of Iwo Jima told from the Japanese perspective through discovered letters, a companion piece to Flags of Our Fathers

works.title: Tora! Tora! Tora!
works.creator: Richard Fleischer
works.description: Documentary-style recreation of the attack on Pearl Harbor from both American and Japanese perspectives, praised for its meticulous historical accuracy

works.title: The Longest Day
works.creator: Ken Annakin
works.description: Epic recreation of D-Day told from American, British, French, and German perspectives with an all-star cast

works.title: Saving Private Ryan
works.creator: Steven Spielberg
works.description: WWII film following a squad searching for the last surviving brother of four servicemen, opening with the most realistic depiction of D-Day ever filmed

works.title: Dunkirk
works.creator: Christopher Nolan
works.description: Ticking-clock war thriller depicting the evacuation of Allied soldiers from the beaches of Dunkirk, told across three timelines on land, sea, and air

works.title: Midway
works.creator: Roland Emmerich
works.description: War film depicting the pivotal Battle of Midway in 1942, the turning point of the Pacific War, from the perspectives of American naval aviators

works.title: Hacksaw Ridge
works.creator: Mel Gibson
works.description: True story of Desmond Doss, the first conscientious objector to receive the Medal of Honor

works.title: Unbroken
works.creator: Angelina Jolie
works.description: True story of Louis Zamperini, an Olympic runner who survived 47 days adrift at sea and years as a Japanese POW during World War II

works.title: Darkest Hour
works.creator: Joe Wright
works.description: Churchill's first days as Prime Minister during the crisis of Dunkirk

works.title: The Zulu
works.creator: Cy Endfield
works.description: Epic depicting the Battle of Rorke's Drift where 150 British soldiers defended a mission station against 4,000 Zulu warriors during the Anglo-Zulu War

works.title: The Battle of Algiers
works.creator: Gillo Pontecorvo
works.description: Neorealist film depicting the Algerian struggle for independence from France, so realistic it has been used as both a revolutionary handbook and counterinsurgency training film

works.title: Hotel Mumbai
works.creator: Anthony Maras
works.description: Thriller depicting the 2008 Mumbai terrorist attacks from the perspective of the staff and guests trapped inside the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel

works.title: Argo
works.creator: Ben Affleck
works.description: Thriller about the CIA operation to rescue six American diplomats from Iran during the 1979 hostage crisis by disguising them as a Canadian film crew

works.title: Zero Dark Thirty
works.creator: Kathryn Bigelow
works.description: Thriller depicting the decade-long hunt for Osama bin Laden culminating in the Navy SEAL raid on his compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan

works.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
works.creator: Michael Bay
works.description: Action film depicting the 2012 attack on the American diplomatic compound in Benghazi and the CIA contractors who fought to defend it

works.title: Ip Man
works.creator: Wilson Yip
works.description: Biographical martial arts film about Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man during the Japanese invasion of China, the man who would later train Bruce Lee

works.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
works.creator: Ken Loach
works.description: Palme d'Or winner about two Irish brothers who join the IRA during the Irish War of Independence and find themselves on opposite sides during the Civil War

works.title: Timbuktu
works.creator: Abderrahmane Sissako
works.description: Poetic drama about life under jihadist occupation in Timbuktu, Mali, showing the absurdity and cruelty of extremist rule with quiet dignity

works.title: Theeb
works.creator: Naji Abu Nowar
works.description: Coming-of-age adventure set during the Arab Revolt, following a young Bedouin boy who must survive after becoming separated from his brother in the desert

works.title: Embrace of the Serpent
works.creator: Ciro Guerra
works.description: Visionary film following two journeys through the Colombian Amazon 40 years apart, exploring the impact of colonialism on indigenous people
